final: WITH j AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name, cs.points AS pts FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId), g AS (SELECT race_name, AVG(pts) AS avg_pts FROM j GROUP BY race_name), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pts) AS overall FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.race_name, g.avg_pts, g.avg_pts - o.overall AS diff FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE g.avg_pts > o.overall), f AS (SELECT AVG(diff) AS final_avg FROM k) SELECT k.race_name, k.avg_pts, k.diff, k.avg_pts - f.final_avg AS diff_final FROM k CROSS JOIN f
